projects.title: Diamond Juice — No Added Sugar Retail Activation
projects.desc: Directed the creative strategy and visual communication for Diamond Juice's No Added Sugar retail activation, translating brand objectives into a cohesive, benefit-led retail experience. Established a consistent communication hierarchy across packaging, shelf wobblers, gondola displays, and in-store branding to strengthen product visibility, reinforce brand positioning, and drive purchase consideration at the point of sale.

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk — KV & POSM Communication System
projects.desc: Led the creative direction and development of a scalable nutritional claim identity for Diamond UHT Milk, transforming the "9 Vitamins & 6 Minerals" proposition into a distinctive visual communication system. Established a consistent design hierarchy across three packaging formats to enhance benefit visibility, strengthen brand consistency, and reinforce product differentiation at the point of purchase.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: Communicating multiple nutritional benefits across different packaging formats while preserving Diamond Milk's established brand identity and ensuring strong visibility in a competitive retail environment.
Develop a distinctive and scalable nutritional claim system that enhances consumer understanding, strengthens on-pack communication, and maintains consistency across the Diamond UHT Milk portfolio.
sections.heading: Objective

sections.body: Established a benefit-led visual hierarchy, introducing a recognizable claim badge supported by clear typography and a unified design treatment. The system was adapted across three packaging formats, balancing nutritional messaging, brand recognition, and individual pack proportions.
sections.heading: Creative Strategy

sections.body: Developed a cohesive packaging communication system with consistent nutritional claim visibility across three pack formats, providing a scalable design approach for maintaining brand coherence throughout the product range.
sections.heading: Outcome

projects.title: Integrated Campaign Strategy, Creative Direction & Consumer Experience.
projects.desc: Directed the creative development of an integrated Diamond Fresh Milk campaign, translating marketing strategy into a cohesive brand experience across key visuals, retail environments, consumer activations, and branded merchandise. Established a unified visual direction to strengthen product positioning, enhance retail visibility, and deliver consistent brand communication across multiple consumer touchpoints.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: Translate Diamond Fresh Milk's nutritional positioning into an engaging and consistent campaign experience across diverse consumer touchpoints, while ensuring strong brand recognition and clear product messaging.

Develop an integrated visual communication ecosystem that reinforces nutritional benefits, strengthens retail visibility, and encourages consumer interaction through both physical and experiential brand activations.
sections.heading: Objective

sections.body: Established a unified campaign identity built around the "Nutrisi Lengkap, Proses Tepat" proposition. Extended the creative direction across campaign key visuals, branded chillers, retail displays, interactive fitness activations, and promotional merchandise to maintain a cohesive brand experience throughout the consumer journey.
sections.heading: Creative Strategy

sections.body: Developed a comprehensive campaign visual system connecting brand awareness, in-store visibility, experiential engagement, and branded merchandise. The integrated approach provided a consistent creative framework across multiple channels and consumer touchpoints.
sections.heading: Outcome

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk Marshmallow — Packaging Identity & Brand Experience
projects.desc: Directed the packaging identity development for Diamond UHT Milk Marshmallow, translating a playful product proposition into a distinctive, character-led visual system. Established a cohesive design direction across 125 ml and 200 ml formats, balancing brand consistency, product differentiation, and shelf visibility while extending the packaging identity into engaging lifestyle and consumer brand experiences.

sections.body: Develop a distinctive packaging identity for Diamond UHT Milk Marshmallow that captures the playful character of the flavor while maintaining clear brand recognition and consistent communication across different pack sizes.
sections.heading: Challenge

sections.body: Build a recognizable and engaging packaging system that enhances product differentiation, strengthens visual appeal, and reinforces Diamond Milk's identity within its flavored milk portfolio.
sections.heading: Objective

sections.body: Established a character-led design direction combining vibrant pink and purple tones, rainbow elements, expressive typography, and playful product illustrations. Developed a scalable visual hierarchy adaptable to 125 ml and 200 ml formats, ensuring the brand, flavor identity, and nutritional information remain clearly communicated.
sections.heading: Creative Strategy

sections.body: Developed a cohesive packaging identity across two product formats, supported by a consistent visual direction for product storytelling and lifestyle applications. The design system balances playful brand expression with structured packaging communication and strong shelf recognition.
sections.heading: Outcome

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk 200ml — Variant Packaging Extension
projects.desc: Diamond UHT Milk needed to expand its 200ml range with new flavour variants while maintaining a consistent, recognizable brand identity. The strategy balanced Diamond Milk's core identity with stronger flavour cues, colour differentiation, and character treatment — resulting in a range that became a Top 2 best-seller on shelves.

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk Marshmallow — Packaging Design
projects.desc: Before Bubble Gum, there was Marshmallow. The challenge wasn't simply making the pack look playful or colourful — it was giving Marshmallow its own distinctive personality while ensuring it still felt unmistakably Diamond, through character design, colour, and a clear claim hierarchy for the 10 Vitamin 5 Mineral benefit. Designed to live beyond the pack, not just sit on the shelf.

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk Bubble Gum — Packaging Design
projects.desc: Packaging is not only about making something look good — it needs to make the product easier to notice, understand, and remember. The challenge was finding the right balance between something playful enough for a younger audience while keeping the visual language clearly connected to the Diamond brand, built around a flexible system that lets Bubble Gum stand out on shelf without losing brand recognition.

projects.title: Diamond Milk Bubble Gum — Campaign Key Visual
projects.desc: Developed to strengthen awareness and visibility for Diamond UHT Milk Bubble Gum across digital and outdoor touchpoints, combining marketing and design objectives through bright colours, flavour cues, and dynamic product-focused visuals for stronger attention, appeal, and memorability.

projects.title: Internal Branding — Employee Engagement Merchandise
projects.desc: A shirt design built to support internal branding, employee engagement, and a stronger sense of belonging — a wearable brand asset using playful illustration, simple brand placement, and a positive message that turned internal merchandise into an everyday brand advocacy tool.

projects.title: Diamond Professional Mayonnaise 1KG — NPD Packaging
projects.desc: Developed the packaging design for a 1KG foodservice mayonnaise distributed through baking supply stores, supported by a key visual and in-store activation materials to strengthen product visibility and communicate its versatility for various food creations.

projects.title: Diamond Marley — Packaging Redesign
projects.desc: Packaging rejuvenation isn't always about making something look completely new — sometimes it's about understanding what should stay, and what needs to work better. The previous Marley packaging already had strong chocolate-category recognition, so the bigger opportunity was in the system: a clearer brand hierarchy between Diamond, Marley, and DARK/WHITE, stronger variant navigation through colour and typography, more appetising food visuals, and a new “Good For” section showing how each variant can be used — all while keeping what people already recognise.

projects.title: Master Milk Tomoro x Diamond — Barista Edition
projects.desc: An NPD packaging project for Master Milk Barista Edition, developed for the foodservice channel with Tomoro Coffee. I created a clear hierarchy with Master Milk Barista Edition as the main focus, balancing both Diamond and Tomoro brand identities in one uncrowded design.

projects.title: Sayang Liquid Berry Peony — Packaging Design
projects.desc: Developed Berry Peony as a new variant for Sayang Liquid Detergent, including packaging for the 300ml and 600ml sizes. Rather than treating the pack as a standalone decoration, the visual system was built around three priorities: brand recognition, sensory appeal, and clear benefit communication — introducing a more contemporary, expressive expression for Sayang while keeping it warm and familiar. Developed together with the Sayang Brand Team, including Brigitta Pricillia (Brand Manager) and Retno Puspa Wardhany (Graphic Design Supervisor).
